sources.snippet: A small Hybrid implementation for Classification, packaged with an explicit configuration and an initialization checkpoint. The nano variant is a reproducible starting point, not a trained model release.

sources.title: Free AI Models on OpenRouter
sources.snippet: Free models let you prototype, learn, and run side projects on almost no budget, and OpenRouter keeps expanding free capacity by onboarding providers and covering costs directly. If you would rather not choose, openrouter/free routes each request to a free model that fits it.
